answer: Each identity posts a bond locked twelve epochs on a superlinear curve: the nth identity costs n squared times ten POA, so ten fakes cost 3,850 POA, not 100. The juniper beacon publishes a fresh seed, and each bond ties to one hardware key plus a liveness check in that epoch, so one key cannot back a reef of clones. A random audit jury slashes the whole bond if two identities share a key, device fingerprint, or funding trail, and one island of honest history cannot vouch for a crowd. Limits: wealthy attackers can still buy in and the curve prices out poor newcomers, so add rebates, appeals.
